purpose: Register a one-factor paired screen for horizon-step-specific reliability in the static train-only ACF memory path while retaining the AutoCon signed relation objective.
research_question: When the legal forecast support of ACF lags changes across the horizon, does stepwise reliability preserve or improve validation forecasting relative to the existing horizon-aggregated reliability gate under an identical MambaACF AutoCon contract?
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory H96 screen on ETTh1 and traffic with three paired seeds per arm. It is mechanism evidence only and cannot establish a general Mamba, ACF, AutoCon, accuracy, efficiency, or publication claim.
claim_boundary: Only paired validation scaled-MSE/MAE, seed dispersion, and predeclared ACF diagnostics may be reported. The stepwise flag changes forecast-memory gating only; it does not make the full representation grid strictly causal and must not be presented as a universal improvement.

required_before_launch: human review of the one-factor stepwise reliability question and H96 scope
verify the current source snapshot, environment record, and both dataset SHA256 fingerprints
run the current-source parameter and device-resident resource smoke for both arms
freeze this JSON, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root
select or stop an arm using validation metrics only

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, reliability arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh exploratory output root. Retain the immutable runner source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan hash, config hashes, manifest, train-only ACF prior, validation trajectory, loss diagnostics, checkpoint, and phase validation. Do not copy historical metrics or checkpoints into this matrix.

phases.name: step_reliability_off_h96
phases.purpose: Existing horizon-aggregated static raw-prior reliability gate, retained as the paired reference.

phases.name: step_reliability_on_h96
phases.purpose: The same static raw-prior memory and AutoCon relation contract with horizon-step-specific reliability enabled.

pairing_contract.interpretation: The paired contrast estimates only the incremental effect of replacing horizon-aggregated reliability with per-step reliability. It does not identify the effect of the ACF prior, Mamba operator, or relation objective in isolation.

accuracy_gate.stepwise_vs_aggregate: In each dataset, mean validation scaled-MSE ratio stepwise/aggregate <= 1.000, at least 2 of 3 paired seed wins, and no seed-level ratio above 1.05.
accuracy_gate.diagnostic_gate: Persist finite gate mean, seasonal RMS, effective-memory RMS, and effective-memory-to-forecast RMS for every completed epoch; a missing diagnostic invalidates the mechanism readout.
accuracy_gate.uncertainty: Report every seed, paired delta, mean/median ratio, and a paired confidence interval. Do not pool ETTh1 and traffic as independent replicates.

resource_gate.protocol: Measure both configurations on the same current source snapshot with device-resident synthetic inputs, fixed batch and timing repeats, and report parameter, peak-memory, median-latency, and p95-latency deltas.
resource_gate.budget: The stepwise arm may not exceed 1.10x the aggregate arm in median latency or steady-state peak allocated memory; this is a screening budget, not a speed claim.
resource_gate.missing_measurement: Any source-mismatched, mixed-device, or missing resource row invalidates the efficiency comparison.

comparison_contract.promotion_rule: Promote only after all 12 jobs have complete paired artifacts, both phase validators pass, diagnostics are present, and a new human-reviewed confirmation plan is frozen. This draft cannot establish a paper result.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validation and dry-run expansion are the only permitted actions for this draft.
Do not use test metrics or historical artifacts to change the one-factor arm definition, seeds, horizon, or lambda after observing validation results.
If stepwise reliability fails the accuracy gate or adds measured cost without a benefit, retain the aggregate reference and stop this branch.
Do not promote a favorable H96 result to longer horizons, strict representation-causality claims, or universal ACF claims without an independently frozen confirmation matrix.
